source.author: Kay Lousberg; Avatar Studio adaptations
source.library: KayKit Character Animations 1.1 and authored anatomical adaptation
source.adaptation: KayKit Lie_Down pelvis-height progress contributes 35% of the transition clock; clock is slowed to five seconds. Poses are authored supported sitting/reclining paths fitted to target skin and limb lengths, not copied source joint curves.

source.author: Kay Lousberg; Avatar Studio adaptations
source.library: KayKit Character Animations 1.1 and authored anatomical adaptation
source.adaptation: Project-authored static anatomical rest. KayKit Lie_Idle supplies the floor-rest reference family and 2.666667 second hold duration only. No breathing, captured sleep or source pose curves are claimed.

source.author: Kay Lousberg; Avatar Studio adaptations
source.library: KayKit Character Animations 1.1 and authored anatomical adaptation
source.adaptation: Project-authored two-second side roll or exact reversed return, with matched state endpoints and target-surface fitting. KayKit is a reference for the overall Lie family, not a captured or copied roll.

sleepArmRepair.scope: Six side-roll/rest/return clips; six arm quaternion channels, hand contact flags and conservative preview bounds. Body, feet and root retained.
sleepArmRepair.contactNote: Nominal 4 mm sampled hand clearance; reach limits may leave classic hands at about 3.5–3.7 mm. Authored support, not force simulation.
